newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Consob gives green light to SEAT listing.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Consob gives green light to SEAT listing.

text.p: Italy's stock market authority Consob has approved the Milan bourse listing of yellow pages publisher SEAT from January 2, 1997.

Earlier this week, state-controlled telecoms holding group STET said that its spin off of SEAT was complete and would take effect on December 31, while the shares would start trading on January 2 with Consob's approval.

STET said last month it intended to issue 3.834 million ordinary shares and 1.447 million savings shares of nominal value of 50 lire to be allocated to STET shareholders in the ratio of one SEAT share to every STET share held.
